item.title: Dr. Elmer S. Imes #BlackHistoryMonth
item.description: Dr. Elmer Samuel Imes was the second African American to earn a Ph.D. in physics and the first in the 20th century. A major contributor to modern physics, Imes’ work provided an early verification of Quantum Theory and his research led to four patents for instruments that were used for measuring magnetic and electric properties.
